parsed.rationale_overall: Both systems provide well-personalized, risk-aligned advice, but System B offers more specific, actionable instruments (SHV/VGSH/SUB, VNQ/O, MUB/VTEB) with concrete dollar amounts and adds tax-optimization and REIT diversification that meaningfully improve the portfolio. System A is slightly more grounded (no new tickers introduced) but is less differentiated and its dividend-reinvestment recommendation is weaker given the retiree's income needs.
